## MiniMax H3

[MiniMax H3](https://www.minimax.io/blog/minimax-h3) is MiniMax's general-purpose, omni-modal generation model. It jointly understands text, image, video, and audio, and generates video with **native stereo audio**: voice, sound effects, and music are modeled jointly in a single forward pass, not layered on afterward. Output is up to 2K resolution, 24fps, and up to about 15 seconds.

## ComfyUI links
- [ComfyUI#15224](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/15224)
- [🤗 Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3)

## About this workflow

This template runs the **reference-to-video (ref2va)** task using the `MiniMaxH3ReferenceToVideo` node. It takes any mix of reference images, videos, and standalone audio, and weaves them into the generation to lock in a character's identity, a style, a motion, a camera move, or a voice.

**Key inputs**

- **ref_images / ref_videos / ref_video_audios / ref_audios**: up to 9 reference images, 3 reference videos (each may carry its own paired soundtrack), and 3 standalone reference audio clips
- **prompt**: reference the inputs by tag, in the exact order they were connected, for example `<Picture 1>`, `<Video 1>`, `<Audio 1>`, then describe the target scene, motion, and audio
- **ref_image_size**: `match` scales references down to the generation's resolution (faster); `max` keeps up to a 2048px short edge for stronger identity fidelity, at the cost of speed since reference tokens ride along every sampling step
- **width / height**: set via Resolution Selector.
- **duration (seconds)**: converted to a valid frame `length` by the Math Expression node

**Sampling and decode**

- Sampler: `res_multistep`. `beta` or `normal` scheduler tends to outperform `simple` for reference-heavy prompts like this one
- The sampler's joint audio+video `LATENT` output feeds directly into both `VAEDecode` (video, `minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16`) and `VAEDecodeAudio` (audio, `minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32`); each decode node automatically pulls its own half out of the packed latent. `CreateVideo` then muxes the two into a single MP4 with synced sound
- The diffusion model here is `minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors`, a different set of weights from the `fl2va` model used by the t2v/i2v templates

Ref2va's output is very sensitive to prompt wording; matching the reference tags precisely and being explicit about which reference drives which part of the shot tends to work best.

```text
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the young woman in <Picture 1>, with long straight dark hair, a beige sweatshirt with a dark chest graphic, a soft natural face, and a relaxed, expressive posture.
<Picture 1> is the first frame of [Shot 1], showing <Subject 1> seated by a high-speed train window in a selfie-style composition.

summary:
[keyframe completion + reference generation] The target video is a 10-second handheld selfie-style high-speed train sequence. It begins from <Picture 1> with <Subject 1> filming herself, then pans to the passing scenery outside the window and pans back to her face. <Subject 1> speaks in Chinese during the shot, and the camera movement is continuous, lively, and physically expressive.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3]): fully_preserved - her long dark hair, beige sweatshirt, facial appearance, and relaxed selfie posture are retained.
<Picture 1> ([Shot 1] first frame): fully_preserved - the opening frame matches the supplied image, including the high-speed train interior, window position, lighting, and selfie composition.

detailed_description:
The target video has a bright, natural, vlog-style handheld selfie look with warm sunlight, soft motion blur from the moving train, and a lively personal camera feel.
[Shot 1] The shot begins from <Picture 1>, a close selfie framing of <Subject 1> seated beside a high-speed train window. <Subject 1> holds the camera in front of her face with one arm extended, her long dark hair slightly lifted by the train’s airflow, and sunlight falling across her face and the beige sweatshirt. The train interior is visible behind her, with the window on the right and a patterned seat headrest on the left. She looks into the camera with a relaxed smile and moves her head naturally as the train travels. She begins speaking in a bright, casual Chinese voice, <d>[Chinese] 还有一站就到了，你看这风景，太美了</d>. As she speaks, her body language is active: she tilts her head, shifts her shoulders, and gestures lightly with her free hand near the window frame.
[Shot 2] At 00:04.000, without cutting, the handheld camera swings smoothly toward the train window. The view shifts from <Subject 1>’s face to the bright exterior landscape outside, showing passing scenery with strong motion blur, open sky, distant ground, and sunlight glinting across the glass. The camera keeps the same selfie arm movement, so the transition feels continuous and physically connected to her hand. The sound of the train moving through the environment becomes more prominent as the frame faces the window.
[Shot 3] At 00:07.000, the handheld camera pans back from the window toward <Subject 1>. She re-enters the frame from the left side, her face filling the close selfie view again. She smiles more broadly, turns slightly toward the window, and makes a small pointing or showing gesture toward the scenery with her free hand. Her hair sways with the motion, and her shoulders and upper body move with the rhythm of the train. She ends the line with a bright, satisfied expression, then continues speaking softly as the camera settles into a final selfie framing near the window.

overall_soundscape:
A steady high-speed train hum and soft interior cabin noise continue throughout the video, with occasional gentle wind-like airflow near the window and subtle movement sounds from the seat and clothing.

non_diegetic_music:
N/A
```

For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] The frame opens exactly on <Picture 1>. She is in her early twenties, sitting in a train seat beside the window, holding a phone out in front of her with one hand to film herself. She has long brown hair, and the draft inside the carriage is blowing it across her face and out to one side the whole time. She wears a cream sweatshirt with the sleeves pushed up, and her other hand is raised loosely near her chest. She is smiling into the lens. Behind her is the carriage interior: a patterned fabric headrest cover on the seat in front, a folded tray table, the window frame, and beyond the glass a brilliant blue sky with strings of power lines running past. Sunlight comes through the window and lies across her face, her hair and her shoulder in bright bands. A couple of other passengers sit further down the carriage, out of focus.

The whole video stays in this one seat. She never stands up and never leaves the frame.

This is a handheld selfie, and the camera moves deliberately. The camera starts close on her face, turns slowly away toward the window and travels out across the seat and the window frame until the sky and the passing countryside fill the frame, holds there for a moment, then turns back just as slowly and settles on her face again, where it pushes in very slowly by a small amount and stops. The camera never moves fast and never shakes beyond the ordinary sway of a phone held at arm's length.

Only three things happen in these ten seconds, and each one takes several seconds. She sits and speaks to the camera. The camera turns out to the window and shows the sky and the passing view. The camera comes back to her and she speaks again. Nothing else happens and nothing is rushed.

She moves slowly and naturally the whole time, and never turns quickly or jerks her head. The draft keeps moving her long hair across her face without pause.

Something is always moving in frame, but only what really moves on a train: her hair in the draft, the bright light shifting across her face as the carriage passes in and out of shade, the scenery and the power lines streaming past the window, the sleeve of her sweatshirt, and the other passengers shifting slightly far down the carriage.

She says three lines. For every line you clearly see her mouth open, with the lip movement matching the line word for word, and the mouth closes only after the line is finished. She faces the camera for every line, and nothing covers her mouth, including her own hair.

[Shot 1] She sits in the seat with the sun across her face, holding the phone up in front of her, smiling into the lens, and her hair is blowing across her cheek. She speaks first, bright and casual: <d>[中文] “还有一站就到了。”</d> Then she turns the phone slowly away from her face, and the camera travels out across the seat, past the patterned headrest and the folded tray table, and out through the window frame. The sky fills the frame, a hard brilliant blue, with strings of power lines running past and green fields and low buildings streaming backward below them; the frame brightens as the camera faces the light, and the passing landscape smears with speed at the edges. She lets it stay there for a moment, and while the sky is in frame she says, off the edge of the picture: <d>[中文] “你看这天。”</d> Then the camera turns back just as slowly, past the window frame and the seat, and settles on her face again with the sunlight back across her cheek and her hair still moving. She looks into the lens and smiles wider, and the camera pushes in very slowly by a small amount until her face fills most of the frame. She speaks the last line with a small laugh: <d>[中文] “我到啦。”</d> The frame holds on her face in the sunlight, her hair still crossing her cheek, and ends there.

overall_soundscape: A moving train. Under everything is a steady low rumble from the rails and the carriage body, with a faint high whine that comes and goes as the train changes speed. The window glass carries a constant thin rattle and the air conditioning pushes a continuous low draft across the seats. Every so often two carriages pass in the opposite direction and produce a short, hard rush of wind outside the glass. Further down the carriage, other passengers talk quietly and someone shifts in a seat. She speaks close to the microphone over all of it, bright and casual, and the rumble stays under her voice the whole time. The video ends on the rail rumble, the thin glass rattle and the draft moving her hair.

non_diegetic_music: A light, bright cue on strummed acoustic guitar with a soft four-on-the-floor pulse and a warm bass line, at a medium tempo. It holds steady under her first line. When the camera turns out to the window the music opens up a layer, adding a rising string line that matches the brightness of the sky, and stays open while the landscape is in frame. It eases back down as the camera returns to her, and under the last line it stays soft and simple. The cue ends on one clean chord as the frame closes.
